notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/f17365e0e654b0bec4444883b23206768fd230ff.png"][/img][/p][h1]Resource Changes:[/h1][p][b]1) Summon Damage Adjustment:[/b][/p][p]- Summoned Wolf: Maximum damage 20 (25 >> 20)[/p][p]- Summoned Skeleton: 15/25 (20/30 >> 15/25)[/p][p]- Summoned Elite Skeleton: 20/35 (30/40 >> 20/35)[/p][p]- Summoned Gorilla: Minimum damage 30 (35 >> 30)[/p][p]- Water/Earth Elemental: 65/80 (70/85 >> 65/80)[/p][p]- Wind Elemental: 70/85 (75/90 >> 70/85)[/p][p]- Fire Elemental: 75/90 (80/95 >> 75/90)[/p][p][b]2) Spells:[/b][/p][p]- Summon Wind Elemental: Requires 1030 mana to cast Casting (940 >> 1030)[/p][p]- Summon Fire Elemental: Requires 1200 mana to cast (1010 >> 1200)[/p][p][b]3) Mining:[/b][/p][p]Life and Regeneration Time values ​​have been updated to improve the mining quality of iron and silver ores.[/p][p][b]4) NPCs:[/b][/p][p]- Medusa: Reduces her EXP to 10,000 (10,400 >> 10,000)[/p]

tags.balance_change: - Summoned Wolf: Maximum damage 20 (25 >> 20)
- Summoned Skeleton: 15/25 (20/30 >> 15/25)
- Summoned Elite Skeleton: 20/35 (30/40 >> 20/35)
- Summoned Gorilla: Minimum damage 30 (35 >> 30)
- Water/Earth Elemental: 65/80 (70/85 >> 65/80)
- Summon Wind Elemental: Requires 1030 mana to cast Casting (940 >> 1030)
- Summon Fire Elemental: Requires 1200 mana to cast (1010 >> 1200)
- Medusa: Reduces her EXP to 10,000 (10,400 >> 10,000)

tags.bug:
#945 – Fixed "You have killed the creature" when it was a user and not an NPC (Plus)
Fixes an incorrect message that said you killed a creature when you actually killed another player.
Changed the message sent from Msg184 (which corresponded to the creature message) to Msg76, which is the appropriate message for killing a user. Changed Modulo_UsUaRiOs.bas.

#944 – fix_ForkArtifacts
Hostile NPCs now rotate correctly when they have pets/elementals on their sides.
Fixes artifacts left behind by previous repository forks; rescues a pending revert.

tags.feature:
#949 – feat(server): track server uptime and show on user login (Gulfas)
Implements tracking of server uptime and displays it when a user logs in.
Added the modUptime module, which records the server startup time and calculates a formatted uptime (days, hours, minutes, seconds). Upon successful login, a message with that uptime is sent to the user using FONTTYPE_INFO.

#943 – feature_ElvenItemsReduceSpellCooldownInHalf (Centorios)
Adds functionality so that elven items reduce spell cooldowns by half.
Changes to modHechizos.bas. When the character has a corresponding elven item, the spell cooldown is divided by 2. There are several commits. It has been tested that the cooldown is correctly reduced with elven items.

5) Quest
- The Vulkan NPC in Kamal Village has been enabled: a new quest for the Mage class is available starting at level 31.

tags.balance_change:
1) NPC Defense.
The DEF of the following NPCs has been reduced: Mermaid, Galleon, Purple Deer, Black Deer, Sorceress, Fairy, Ogre, Mutinous Pirate, Cannoneer Pirate, Unleashed Wind Element, Unleashed Fire Element, Demonic Minion, Demonic Minion, Ghanly, Arctic Shaman.
The DEF of the following NPCs has been adjusted: Captain Cedric (10), Specter (10), Forest Spirit (10), Warrior Ogre (10), Ancient Deer (10), Shark (5), Cryptococcus (5), Leviathan (10).
Set DEF = 5 for Dungeon NPCs +27:
- Arachnid Crusher, Azhran (Lair)
- Lynn, Kadru (Nagas)
- Ice Golem, Eyewarden (Glacier Cave)
- Red Dragon, Gold (Dragon's Lair)
- Witch, Medusa (Dragon Veril)

2) Summons.
The hit chance of the following NPCs has been reduced:
- Skeleton: 240 >> 205
- Piranha: 250 >> 210
- Elite Skeleton: 245 >> 215
- Scylla: 250 >> 230
- Gorilla: 250 >> 230
- Earth/Water Elemental: 275 >> 250 - minimum damage reduced by 5: 75 >> 70
- Wind Elemental: 285 >> 260 - damage reduction 85/95 >> 75/90

3) Robe/Armor Defense
The defense values ​​of the following items have been updated:
- Gray Robe: 7/9 >> 6/8
- Red Robe: 8/10 >> 6/8
- Blue Robe: 10/12 >> 8/10
- Aquamarine Robe: 13/15 >> 10/12
- Black Robe: 15/17 >> 13/15
- Forgiving Dress: 15/17 >> 13/15
- Necromancer's Robe: 17/19 >> 15/17
- Wedding Dress: 17/19 >> 15/17
- Ochre Robe: 17/21 >> 15/17
- Red Forgiving Dress: 17/21 >> 15/17
- Erendil's Garb: 18/22 >> 15/19
- Natural Robe: 18/22 >> 15/19
- Leather Armor: 7/9 >> 7/12
- Blue Leather Armor: 9/11 >> 8/12
- Armor Maghtere: 13/15 >> 11/15
- Chainmail: 14/18 >> 15/19
- Ebony Armor: 18/20 >> 19/21
- Knight's Breastplate: 19/21 >> 20/22
- Cloaked Armor: 20/22 >> 21/23
- Plates of Honor: 25/29 >> 27/29
- Items removed from sale and crafting: Gray Robe, Mage's Robe, and Countess's Dress.

4) Spells
The damage value of the following spells has been updated:
- Magic Missile: reduced to 25/35 (30/40 >> 25/35)
- Blazing Flare: minimum damage increased to 30 (25 >> 30)
- Apocalypse: minimum spell damage increased from 91 to 92

6) Druid Pets
Adjusted damage, hit, and attack interval for NPCs:
- Sea Turtle / White Fang: 40/55 damage - 200 hit - 2s attack interval
- Shark / Ursus: 55/70 damage - 220 hit - 2.1s attack interval
- Cryptococcus / Winter Worg: 70/85 damage - 240 hit range - 2.2s attack interval
- Black Panther: 85/100 damage - 260 hit range - 2.3s attack interval

7) Weapons
Damage adjustments for the following items:
- Viking Sword: +2 min / -2 max: 5/15 >> 7/13
- Katana: +1 min / -1 max: 8/16 >> 9/15
- Double-Edged War Axe: +1 min: 10 >> 11
- Shortsword: No longer equippable by the Hunter, Bard, and Assassin classes.

9) Damage and Magic Resistance Balance
Magic Damage and Magic Resistance System Changes:
- Increased the natural magic protection modifier from 0.03 to 0.04 (multiplied by Magic Resistance Skills)
- Increased the mana recovered from the Elven Lute from 12 to 14
Magic Damage Item Changes:
- Elven Lute: from 6% to 7%
- Flute: from 2% to 1%
- Elven Flute: from 7% to 8%
- Wooden Staff: from 3% to 2%
- Gnarled Staff: from 6% to 4%
- Socketed Staff: from 8% to 9%
Magic Resistance Item Changes:
- Wolf Helmet: from 3% to 2%
- Ring of Magic Defense: 2% to 1%
- Elk Antler: 6% to 5%
- Apprentice Hat: 2% to 1%

Also fixed issues with clicking on non-pet NPCs and with the display of Game Master name colors. Finally, backpack display has been added to the character selection screen.

The guild request and membership history will now display unique clan names, removing repetition and improving clarity. Information.

tags.feature: Added property to display an NPC's killer in the console.
Some NPCs will now display who killed them in the game console! This new feature will allow players to keep track of who is defeating certain special enemies.

tags.bug: Fixed the creation and display of groups in event lobbies.

Adjusted lobby forms to ensure players enter correct values. Fixed the group type selector (previously forcing the event to be a hunt) and the group type in the lobbie list (previously displayed as a blank space).
Home screen logo update.
Factional items (Royal = 1 / Chaos = 1) can only be equipped in the Safe Zone (PR#913).
Magic damage fix for Druid pets: they will now correctly add the bonus for having an equipped flute (PR#916).

Improvements to the message system when clicking on a tile and finding a person or NPC. All messages involving clicking on an NPC or person are now translated. The form for creating a lobby from the event creator NPC is now working correctly. Fixed an issue where a hunt would be created when trying to set the group mode. The form now allows you to create all lobby types except the generic one. The blacksmithing form now only shows the items needed to create the item (previously, it showed all materials even if the weapon crafting cost for that item was 0). Added a platform for making professions grant experience.
For now, fishing with rods with a power greater than 2 (reinforced, iron, or net) will grant 1 experience point upon successful fishing (does not scale by quantity).
Added NPC engagement when using immobilize or paralyze.
Increased the time an NPC spends in combat with a user from the last spell or hit cast from 10 to 15 seconds.

Optimized the way messages are sent when observing characters and NPCs, reducing the amount of data transmitted. Additionally, localization has been implemented for all interaction-related messages when clicking on them. Author: Centarios PR: #919

tags.feature: - Added the "elemental" property to NPCs and ITEMS (not yet assigned).

- Added functionality for persistence of user-applied elements when:
> Throwing an enchanted item on the ground.
> Depositing an enchanted item in the bank.
> Move an enchanted item in the inventory
> Trade an enchanted item between users.
- Added "Elemental Runes" craftable by blacksmiths (not yet balanced)
- The Alchemy "recipe" system has been ported to other professions (not yet balanced)
- The system will now have four Elements (Fire, Water, Earth, Wind)
- Added Element interaction with NPCs for both hits and spells (as long as the elemental weapon is equipped)
- Added the ability to enchant an item by dragging an elemental rune onto it.
- All implementation will be handled by a feature toggle (in case it needs to be enabled/disabled)
- The Blodium deposit has been reinstated in the server code.
- Added 4 new crafting requirements for Elemental Runes called "essences."
- Added the Element interaction matrix to the Balance.ini file for future damage adjustments.
- Added new special effects when enchanting an item.

Duke's Attire
Alcarinqua Gala Dress

tags.bug: Fixed issues to improve false positives due to timeouts.

Fixed an issue where the message indicating the required quest did not display the quest name correctly. Message 1424 will now display the quest name in the console, making it easier to understand the requirements for progress.

Hunters no longer resist double paralysis Author: 
Centtorios PR: #903 
The Hunter class was resistant to double paralysis. Now only the Warrior class does.

tags.bug: Fixed and added cities as home.
Fixed an error in assigning the city of Arkhein, and added the cities of Eldoria and Forgat as possible character homes.

tags.feature: Console announcements for all lobby types.
Console announcement messages have been added for different lobby types, providing important information to players.

tags.balance_change: Adjustments to damage and hit chance calculations for summons and NPCs.

Improvements have been made to the combat system. NPC hit chances are now affected by the user's level, but still respect their original values. NPC damage now matches their minimum and maximum damage ranges. Additionally, bonus damage from weapons and accessories now stacks correctly, and stronger mods for high-level items have been added.

tags.feature: New lava visual effect in the game.
A new visual effect has been implemented for lava in the game. Notice the new textures and animations when you are near it.
Runes have been implemented as a consumable item for teleportation.
Runes have returned to Argentum Online! These runes are consumable items that teleport players to different locations. Additionally, a new type of rune has been added for an upcoming Halloween quest.

tags.balance_change: Bandits remain hidden after missing a hit as long as they have 100 stealth.
Bandits will now retain their stealth status even after missing a hit.
Skill leveling difficulty is now progressive, no longer based on ranks.
The difficulty system has been modified to increase skills. Difficulty now increases progressively instead of by rank. The readability of related code has also been improved.

tags.feature: Optimized texture handling with a custom hashtable.

The efficiency of the game's texture management has been improved. This update implements a custom hashtable structure for storing and accessing textures, optimizing loading speed and reducing memory consumption.
Magic resistance percentage visible in-game.
The magic resistance percentage will now be displayed correctly in-game. This visual improvement makes it easier to understand the character's statistics.
A drop has been added to the FAIRY (New Hope) NPC. With this pendant equipped, the wearer gains 75% bonus chance to level up the skill performed.
Added Governors for the cities of Forgat and Eldoria.

tags.feature: Stone Golem (Marabel Dungeon) is now "Scarlath," a new Lich.

notes.title: # 🗞️ Argentum Online (Web) – Dev Update (Últimos 15 Días)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/6465054a5333e405e3022023eca6442e9b80b05e.png"][/img]**July 2025**[/p][p]Over the past two weeks, we've made key advancements in internationalization and new features. Below, we'll share the most significant updates:[/p][p]## 🧰 Developer Tools: Index Creation[/p][p]- Updated and refactored the `IndexByLanguage.bas` file to better handle localized data.[/p][p]- Added an **automatic index creator by language**, facilitating future content expansions.[/p][p]- Minor changes to forms (`Form1.frm`) and project files to improve maintainability and consistency.[/p][p]- All **spells now have multilingual support** for names and descriptions.[/p][p]- Fixed inconsistent and duplicate translations in index files.[/p][p]- Fixed bugs related to **NPC display names**.[/p][p]- Improved internal spell name processing to ensure proper localization by language.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 🌍 Multilanguage Support[/p][p]Argentum Online now supports more than one language![/p][p]- Added translation support for NPC, item, spell, and quest names and descriptions.[/p][p]- The website now automatically remembers your preferred language.[/p][p]- Improved display of translated items on both desktop and mobile.[/p][p]- The wiki and perk pages are now also translated.[/p][p]This change opens the door to a more global community.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 🛠️ Visual Improvements and Fixes[/p][p]- Improved design for the character sales and details section in the user dashboard.[/p][p]- Improved mobile navigation and fixed a bug in the language switcher.[/p][p]- Fixed confusing text and **clearer error messages**.[/p][p]- Removed duplicate translations and added missing ones.[/p][p]- Added an **animated marquee** with the owners visible during the process.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## Coming Soon - 🏠 Player-to-Player House Swapping[/p][p]A long-awaited feature is coming: **house swapping**.[/p][p]- New system for **exchanging properties**.[/p][p]- A **confirmation screen with the exchange cost** is now displayed.[/p][p]We continue working to improve your experience in Argentum Online. Thank you for joining us 🚀[/p]

tags.feature: - Added an **automatic index creator by language**, facilitating future content expansions.

tags.bug: - Fixed inconsistent and duplicate translations in index files.
- Fixed bugs related to **NPC display names**.

tags.feature: - Added translation support for NPC, item, spell, and quest names and descriptions.

tags.bug: - Improved mobile navigation and fixed a bug in the language switcher.
- Fixed confusing text and **clearer error messages**.
- Removed duplicate translations and added missing ones.

tags.feature: - Added an **animated marquee** with the owners visible during the process.
- New system for **exchanging properties**.
- A **confirmation screen with the exchange cost** is now displayed.

[/p][p]Added "Legionary Secure" system.[/p][p]Author: JuanCruzRossa[/p][p]Implemented the "Legionary Secure" system.[/p][p]PR: #537[/p][p]
[/p][p]Updated the loading screen image.[/p][p]Author: Temis-gt[/p][p]Updated the image displayed during the loading screen upon game startup.[/p][p]PR: #540[/p][p]
[/p][p]Language localization fix.[/p][p]Author: ReyarB[/p][p]Implemented a fix to improve language localization within the game. This improvement ensures that text displays correctly based on the selected language.[/p][p]PR: #542[/p][p]

tags.balance_change: - Existing horses now have a speed of 0.6, and the "MOUNT EXCHANGE" NPC has been enabled in Ullathorpe Town Center (Map 1). This NPC offers a quest for each horse and rewards those who own a mount.

- Horses are now purchased on Map 188 (Penthar's Farm), and the horseshoes needed to complete Rider Quests are sold in Ullathorpe. Quest reward items (those with a number) are CONSUMABLE and grant a movement speed boost; the effect is permanent.
- The "Arachnid Mutant Rein" and "Red Dragon Rein" items awarded in Events now have a standard speed of 1.05 and are transferable.
- When you get a kill on a character of a higher level than your own, the score obtained scales by 1 faction point for each higher level of your enemy, up to a maximum of 20 points.
Faction Point bonuses for level differences and kills between rival factions.

Improvements have been made to the faction point system. You will now get a point multiplier for killing members of rival factions, configurable on the server. Additionally, a bonus has been added for killing enemies of a higher level than yours, allowing you to earn up to 20 faction points.

tags.feature: Initial implementation of the Legionario Seguro system.
The initial structure for the Legionario Seguro system has been added to the server, including bundles and events.
Mount system rework: Unified speed and questline dependency.

The mount system has been reworked. All mounts now move at the same speed, which depends on the character's progress in a specific questline. Redundant mounts that served only a cosmetic purpose have been removed.
Error messages and rider information improvements.

tags.bug: Error messages have been added for rider items, and the rider level is now displayed in the /est command. Removed the dice from /est, as this information is now found in the statistics.
WAV file localization fix.
Fixed an issue with the localization of WAV sound files. This fix ensures that game sounds play correctly in the desired language.
Added missing sound when closing action windows. (07/18/25)
Fixed an issue where the sound would not play when closing certain action windows. The gameplay experience will now be more consistent with sound feedback.
Fixed data types in Quests (greater than 255) in frmQuests.
Fixed data types in the Quests form to match server data types, avoiding uncontrolled type conversions.

tags.feature: Added "Legionary Secure" system.
Implemented the "Legionary Secure" system.
Updated the loading screen image.
Updated the image displayed during the loading screen upon game startup.

tags.bug: Language localization fix.
Implemented a fix to improve language localization within the game. This improvement ensures that text displays correctly based on the selected language.
Spanish voice fixes. (07/18/25)
Fixed bugs and/or inconsistencies in the game's Spanish voices.
Tiles engine fix for particle display. (07/18/25)
The data type of the Particle property in the tiles engine has been changed to Integer. This allows numbers greater than 255 to be displayed correctly on the game's particles.

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/c6e2b240a928cf2ed9d3168a22cbf642282a78d7.png"][/img]
[b]Server:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shield deflection probability is now configurable. Author: Centarios PR: #848[/p][/*][/list][p]The shield deflection probability system has been modified. Shield effectiveness can now be configured using a percentage property. A percentage of 100% maintains the current effectiveness, while lower values ​​reduce the shield's effectiveness proportionally. Cosmetic shields can still be set to 0.[/p][list][*][p]Improved validation for the use of unsupported macros. Author: ReyarB PR: #859[/p][/*][/list][p]Strengthened validation for the use of unsupported macros, ensuring that only defined spells can activate them. Code readability has been improved and the groundwork has been paved for future implementations of unsupported spells.[/p][list][*][p]Experience and level bonuses for groups with leadership. Author: Centtorios PR: #852 (UNDER REVIEW) A +1 bonus has been added to the party level delta for characters with Leadership equal to or greater than 15 (Charisma/2). A configurable bonus (currently 1%) has also been added to the experience gained for all party members who meet the Leadership requirement.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Leadership bonus implementation reverted. Author: RecoX PR: #865[/p][/*][/list][p]Leadership bonus functionality has been temporarily reverted due to a bug preventing server compilation. This reversion is intended to ensure game stability while the underlying issue is investigated and resolved.[/p][list][*][p]English localization improvements. Author: ReyarB PR: #861[/p][/*][/list][p]Updates and fixes have been made to the English translation of several game modules, including Tournaments, Events, and Punishments. Additionally, message identifiers have been corrected.[/p][list][*][p]Refactoring of helmet and head assignment logic. Author: ReyarB PR: #862[/p][/*][/list][p]The internal logic for assigning helmets and heads to characters has been refactored. This improves code maintainability and paves the way for future implementations of new types of headgear. No functional changes visible to the player have been introduced.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Macro detection refactoring and improvements. Author: ReyarB PR: #864[/p][/*][/list][p]The macro detection system has been optimized for clarity and maintainability by unifying calls and centralizing logic. Game behavior remains the same, but the internal structure is now cleaner and more scalable, preparing the code for future improvements to macro detection.[/p][list][*][p]PvE Bard class update. Author: Temis-gt PR: #855[/p][/*][/list][p]Adjustments have been made to the Bard class, including declaring variables for lyres, modernizing spell-related code, and introducing meditation bonuses based on the equipped lyre.[/p][list][*][p]Increased maximum imprisonment time. Author: aledg994 PR: #863[/p][/*][/list][p]The maximum time a character can be jailed has been increased.[/p][list][*][p]Automated server, index builder, and client launch. Author: plusin PR: #851[/p][/*][/list][p]Added a BAT script that automates the startup of the server, index builder, and game client. It requires the files to be located in the "C:\\AO20" folder.
[/p][p][b]Client:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pets no longer make noise when walking. Author: Wyr0X PR: #527[/p][/*][/list][p]Pet and summoned creature footstep sounds have been removed to reduce overall noise pollution and make it easier to spot invisible players.[/p][list][*][p]Added a link to the Steam graph to the /showconsole command. Author: Centtorios PR: #526[/p][/*][/list][p]The /showconsole command now displays a direct link to the Argentum Online activity graph on Steam.[/p][list][*][p]Changed the variable type for jail time. Author: aledg994 PR: #528[/p][/*][/list][p]The variable type that stores jail time has been changed from byte to integer. This allows for greater precision and prevents potential overflows when calculating sentence time.[/p][list][*][p]Added a window for selecting skins. Author: ReyarB PR: #519[/p][/*][/list][p]A new window has been implemented that allows players to more easily select and change their character's appearance (skins).
[/p][p][b]Items:[/b][/p][list][*][p]War Mace: Increases minimum damage to 11 (9 >> 11)[/p][/*][*][p]Lute: When equipped, the bard class increases each meditation by 5 points[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Lute: When equipped, the bard class increases each meditation by 10 points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Elven Lute: When equipped, the bard class increases each meditation by 15 points

[b]Server:[/b]

- Implemented faction chat via console.
Author: aledg994 PR: #830
A new faction chat system has been implemented. Players will be able to communicate with members of their faction using the /FMSG command. Requires an update in the game client.

- Translated clan messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #836
Translated clan messages have been implemented, allowing for better communication between members of different languages.

- Gold has been refunded when canceling the Capture the Flag event due to a lack of players.
Author: Centtorios PR: #838
Now, if the Capture the Flag event is automatically canceled due to not enough players, the gold used for registration will be refunded.

- Fixed handling of localized messages in the protocol.
Author: ReyarB PR: #840
Fixed a protocol error that prevented localized messages from displaying correctly in certain cases. Messages should now display correctly for all players.

- Implemented the Arena system on the server.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #839
Implemented server-side logic for the Arena system, allowing players to interact with specific NPCs to enter arenas. Requires client-side implementation to fully function.

- Updated the arena entry message due to lack of gold.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #842
The message displayed when a user attempts to enter the arena and does not have enough gold has been updated. The message ID 2040 now appears.

- Increased the maximum entry price for maps.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #841
The maximum value that can be set as the entry price for a map has been increased.

- Lindos Arena is now a zone where potions are not consumed.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #843
The game has been modified so that when in Lindos Arena, potions are not consumed upon use.

- Improvements to the logic for areas without potions and arena validation.
Author: RecoX PR: #845
Improvements have been made to the function that defines zones where potions cannot be used. The code is now more readable and maintainable, and arena-specific validation has been added to ensure proper operation.

notes.title: Patch Notes (22/05/25)
notes.content:
[b]Server:[/b]

- Validation of user descriptions against banned words.
Author: aledg994 PR: #796
A system was implemented to prevent users from using offensive words or phrases in their descriptions. The game will now automatically check descriptions against a list of banned terms.

- Implemented visual effects for hitting and stabbing.
Author: aledg994 PR: #819
Visual effects have been added to the game. Taking damage from hitting will now display a blood effect. Taking stabbed damage will now display a distinctive visual effect.

- Fixed a compilation error when renaming a subroutine.
Author: aledg994 PR: #820
Fixed a compilation error caused by an incorrect name in a subroutine call. This fix ensures that the game compiles correctly.

- Refactoring of the potion consumption logic and addition of potion-free zones.
Author: RecoX PR: #821
The potion consumption logic has been refactored to improve code readability and maintainability. A new function, IsPotionFreeZone, has been introduced to centralize the conditions that determine whether a user is in a zone where potions are not consumed (tournament zones, training zones, etc.). This simplifies the main code and makes the logic easier to understand.

- Unified and consistent welcome message.
Author: ReyarB PR: #823
The welcome message has been modified to be consistent in all cases, providing a clear and consistent message for all players.

- Fixed missing value in donations.
Author: ReyarB PR: #824
Fixed an issue where a value was missing when processing donations, ensuring they were recorded correctly.

- NPC names displayed by ID for better localization.
Author: ReyarB PR: #822
The server now sends the NPC's ID number instead of the name. This allows the client to use the correct language when displaying the NPC's name.

- Added IDs for clan messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #829
Unique identifiers have been added to clan messages. This internal technical improvement facilitates future development and management of communication within clans.

- Migration of login and logout messages to JSON.
Author: ReyarB PR: #826
The structure of login and logout messages has been modified to use the JSON format, improving internal data management.

[b]Client:[/b]

- Fixed missing text in the Harassed Inn shop menu.
Author: ReyarB PR: #511
Fixed a bug in the Hosted Inn shop menu where the word "valor" was missing. JSON was used to handle Spanish and English text, ensuring that both languages ​​display the correct information.

- Message localization update.
Author: ReyarB PR: #513
Multilingual support was implemented in the FrmQuestInfo form by converting two messages to IDs. Additionally, several DisplayError messages were migrated to IDs to support multiple languages. The Trainer message and new text were added to the 1.json and 2.json files.

- IDs were implemented for error messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #514
Static error messages were replaced with IDs, which will allow for future game localization and multi-language support.

- Game menus are now translated and localized.
Author: ReyarB PR: #515
Interaction menus with non-player characters (NPCs), Game Masters (GMs), and other users will now be displayed in the language selected in-game. This improvement provides a more intuitive and accessible experience for all players.

- Updated NPC name localization.
Author: ReyarB PR: #512
The way the server sends NPC name information has been updated. The client now resolves the name based on the language only in specific messages that contain the NPC's name. Other messages will remain unchanged.

- New format for localized clan messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #516
The clan message system has been updated to support a new format that allows for better localization and customization. Messages will now display more accurate information that is adaptable to different languages.

- Added support for empty labels in the game interface.
Author: ReyarB PR: #517
Labels have been added to indicate empty fields in the game interface, improving clarity and user experience in both Spanish and English.

[b]Spells:[/b]
- Summon Gorilla (NEW): Available for sale in the city of Eleusis, only for the BARD and CLERIC classes.

[b]Items:[/b]
- Arrow +2: Now requires level 25 to use (no longer sold, only for carpentry).
- Elven Arrow: Now requires level 33 to use.

- Buckler: Increases its max defense to 4 (3 >> 4)
- Wizard Hat: Reduces its min/max defense to 8/12 (previously 14/16)
- Reinforced Buckler: Increases its min/max defense to 4/6 (previously 3/5)
- High Wizard Hat: Reduces its min/max defense to 11/15 (previously 17/19)
- Oaken Shield: Increases its min/max defense to 6/8 (previously 5/7)
- Valley Shield: Reduces its max defense to 9 (10 >> 9)
- Sorcerer's Hat: Reduces its min/max defense to 15/19 (previously 21/23)
- Ebony Armor: Increases its min/max defense to 18/20 (previously 17/19)
- Knight's Breastplate: Increases its min/max defense to 19/21 (previously 18/20)
- Cloaked Armor: Increases min/max defense to 20/22 (previously 19/21)

[b]Quest:[/b]
- New quest for characters who have previously completed "Leviathan's Fiery Heart." Requires a minimum level of 27, grants a damage boost to the PvE spell Blaze of Fire, consumes 85 mana, and requires 67 Magic skills. The NPC is in Forgat.
- "Clear the Entrance" fix: This quest is only allowed from level 10 to level 15 inclusive.
- "Final Rest" fix: This quest is only allowed from level 9 to level 14 inclusive, and grants 590 XP and 125 gold.

[b]NPCs:[/b]
- The Silver Golem NPC has been added to Map 52 (Depths of the Mines): its respawn time ranges from 21,600 to 36,000 seconds and it has a guaranteed drop rate of 50 Silver Ingots.
- Medusa: grants 10,400 experience points (11,200 >> 10,400)

notes.content:
[b]Client:[/b]

- Message Box Handling
Author: ReyarB PR: #491
Message Box handling has been implemented.

- Text correction: "Fails", "Failed".
Author: ReyarB PR: #492
Fixed text errors related to the words "Fails" and "Failed" in the game.

- Updated the GM menu with support for multiple languages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #493
Messages within the Game Master (GM) menu have been translated to allow viewing in different languages. This improves the experience for GMs whose primary language is not Spanish.

- Bug fixes in ban messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #494
Fixed errors related to the *.JSON format in ban commands. This ensures that bans are applied correctly.

- Updated character publishing price.
Author: RecoX PR: #498
The character publishing cost has been changed to 35,000 gold. This change was implemented to ensure consistency across all game languages.

[b]Server:[/b]

- NPC name fixes.
Author: ReyarB PR: #786
Fixed an issue that prevented NPC names from displaying correctly. NPC names will now be displayed correctly.

- Reverted the worker order in the GM command protocol.
Author: ReyarB PR: #789
Reverted the command line order of GM protocol workers.

- Fixed the error message when using the /hide command.
Author: ReyarB PR: #787
Fixed a bug that caused the wrong message to be displayed when attempting to use the /hide command. The game will now display the correct message indicating whether the command was executed successfully or if there is any impediment.

Several ID-related issues have been fixed in the DeathMatch game mode.

- Teleportation message fixes.
Author: ReyarB PR: #790

- Experience penalty for killing lower-level NPCs. [b](NOT IMPLEMENTED, ONLY THE CODE THAT WILL ALLOW IT TO BE DONE)[/b]
Author: aledg994 PR: #773
A system was designed that penalizes experience gained by defeating NPCs significantly lower than the player's level. After a level difference of 4, a 5% penalty will be applied for each additional level, ensuring that the experience gained is never negative.

Author: ReyarB PR: #792
New translations have been added to the game. This update will improve the gameplay experience for users of different languages ​​and correct existing translation errors.

- New DeathMatch IDs added.

New DeathMatch IDs have been added.

notes.title: Patch Notes (04/30/25)
notes.content:
[b]Client:[/b]

- Easy Anti-Cheat loading image updated. PR: #479 Author: RecoX
The image displayed during Easy Anti-Cheat loading has been replaced.

- EOS SDK updated to version 1.17. PR: #480 Author: morgolock
The EOS SDK (Epic Online Services) has been updated to version 1.17. This update may include bug fixes, performance improvements, or new features related to the game's online services.

- Arrow cursor when taming with graphical cursors. PR: #482 Author: aledg994
Pressing the taming key with graphical cursors enabled will now display the arrow cursor.

- Fixed the "Do you want to open the browser now?" message. PR: #483 Author: ReyarB
Fixed a bug in the "Do you want to open the browser now?" message, improving gameplay clarity.

- Robust handling of malformed or unknown packets when receiving data. PR: #484 Author: morgolock
Game stability has been improved by more safely handling corrupted or unknown data packets. Now, instead of generating errors that could cause problems, the game logs these incidents and continues playing, preventing potential client crashes.

- Removal of unnecessary commented lines of code. PR: #485 Author: ReyarB
Removed commented lines of code that were no longer needed. This helps keep the code cleaner and more readable.

- Corrected the "Exit" text in English. PR: #488 Author: ReyarB
Fixed the translation of "Exit" into English, along with minor adjustments to queries and the "retar" command.

[b]Server:[/b]

- System message fixes (party, taming, experience). PR: #769 Author: aledg994
Identifiers and correct display of system messages related to party creation, the level-based taming message, and experience loss when away from the party leader have been fixed.

- EOS SDK updated to version 1.17. PR: #767 Author: morgolock
The Epic Online Services SDK has been updated to version 1.17. This update may include bug fixes and stability improvements related to online services.

- Faulty telemetry removed. PR: #770 Author: morgolock
The telemetry system that was causing errors and impacting game performance has been removed.

- Game messages are now identified by ID. PR: #771 Author: ReyarB
A message ID identification system has been implemented. This internal improvement makes it easier to manage and locate game messages.

- English translation of commands and server information. PR: #778 Author: ReyarB
English translations have been added for game commands and server information. This allows English-speaking players to interact with the game more fluidly.

- Removal of unnecessary commented lines. PR: #777 Author: ReyarB
Commented lines of code that were no longer needed have been removed. This cleanup improves code readability and maintainability.

notes.content:
[b]Upcoming Update in MAO – Effective May 5th, 2025[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/4d3730a8e95a8f0fe762c0032b0e484ad55fe510.png[/img]

Dear adventurers,

We announce some updates coming to the Market Argentum Online (MAO) starting [b]May 5th, 2025[/b]:

- The commission on sales will be set at 15%.

[b]With these changes,[/b] we can continue expanding the project, improving server stability, and adding new features to Argentum Online, making the experience even better for all players.

Thank you for being a vital part of our world. Your activity and support help Argentum Online grow stronger every day!

[b]See you in the adventure![/b]

— The Argentum Online Team

notes.title: Premium Inventory Slots Are Back – Starting April 23rd!
notes.content:
[b]Premium Inventory Slots Are Back – Starting April 23rd![/b]



Greetings adventurers,

We’re excited to announce that Premium Inventory Slots are making their return to Argentum Online — and the patch goes live on [b]April 23rd[/b]!

[b]What are Premium Slots?[/b]  
These are extra rows in your character’s inventory unlocked through an active Patreon subscription. Depending on your tier, you’ll gain more space for loot, resources, and rare items:

Aventurero: +1 extra row  
Héroe: +2 extra rows  
Leyenda: +3 extra rows

[b]Important – Please Read Carefully[/b]  
Starting April 23rd, if you reduce or cancel your subscription, you will lose access to the premium rows that don’t match your current tier.  
Any items stored in inaccessible rows will be automatically deleted when you log in to the game.

[b]To help you manage this:[/b]  
- Characters with items in premium-only slots will now receive in-game alerts in MAO.  
- You can always check your current subscription tier from the 'My Account' section on our website.

To avoid losing important items, please verify your subscription status before entering the game.

Thank you for supporting AO — your contributions help us grow and keep the world alive!

— The Argentum Online Team

notes.title: How will resource farming and crafting work in Argentum Online?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/483b62d910fedc9a0d3230b1452dfbd14c5f657d.jpg[/img]

On this occasion, we will share new information about the extraction and collection of Resources within Argentum Online:

[b]Tailoring:[/b]
From the start of the version there will be 3 types of skins within Argentum Online, with 2 copies of each, which are:

- Wolf Skin / Black Wolf Skin
- Brown Bear Skin / Polar Bear Skin
- Tiger Skin / Bengal Tiger Skin

These skins fall to the ground after killing the NPC in question, being farmable with any class within the game.

Link to the Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/sastreria

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Alchemy:[/b]
Worker characters will be able to craft various potions within Argentum Online, through this Quest system that will allow them to learn the Recipes for them.

The NPC Caelum, inside the city of Penthar, will offer us a quest system, where the rewards will be the Alchemy recipes, being only learnable by the Worker class.

At the beginning of the season, Life, Mana, Energy, Strength, Agility and Antidotes potions will be available for crafting.

Link to the Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/alquimia

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Carpentry:[/b]

The extraction of Firewood within Argentum Online is in Unsafe areas; there are two types of Firewood, Common and Elven.

- Common firewood is extracted within the Logging areas, which you can see in the REFERENCES section, within the game map, or in the manual section.

- Elven Wood is obtained from level 23, which is when the Worker class can use the Boat to Sail and access the Elven Forest.

The items that can be created with these two types of wood are found in the Carpentry section of the game manual.

Link to Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/talar
Carpentry: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/carpinteria

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Mining and Blacksmithing:[/b]

There are 4 types of minerals in Argentum Online: Coal, Iron, Silver and Gold.

- Coal is mined with a Worker in the Mines of Doom, north of Forgat
- Iron is mined in the Iron Mines, south of Ullathorpe
- Silver is mined on Otto Island, northwest of Nix, starting at level 23
- Gold is mined in Dungeon Veril, starting at level 33

Link to Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/minar
Blacksmith: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/herreria

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Fishing:[/b]
The obtaining of Gold through the sale of Fish is now oriented to the Unsafe zone. You can continue fishing in the Safe zone, but the profit will not be the same as always.
[b]Important clarification: [/b]Fishing Skills **DO NOT INCREASE** in the Safe zone.

Link to the Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/pescar

In the next few days we will continue to inform you more news about the next season, stay tuned for the announcements. Greetings!

notes.title: Inventory Expansion for Heroes and Legends
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/671aab556cc4d51cd5fd5a64f69ed1730a719247.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce an exclusive inventory expansion for our active Hero and Legend subscribers! Starting today, your characters will benefit from additional inventory space to help you carry more gear and treasures on your adventures.

- Hero Tier: Gain 1 additional inventory row.

notes.title: Latest News [06/28]
notes.content:
Dear players, we share information about what's next in Argentum Online:

The current season will end on July 4, giving rise to a new short season that will begin on Friday, July 5 at 7 p.m. Patreon members will have a day in advance to reserve the nickname they want, and at the beginning of the new season they will be able to enter the game with their already created character. Patreon users no longer have 24-hour early access.

The new version will have a short duration of 27 days (closes Thursday, August 1), so the multipliers will be:
- Experience x20
- Gold x10
- Extraction x5

This new season will have a big change in mapping: the old and new continents have been unified into one, and several dungeons and +25 training areas have been limited. The reason for the latter is to emulate the beginning of version x1 in September, where the map will be enabled through user surveys.

We hope to have you and continue improving Argentum Online day by day, preparing in the best possible way for the long season of September 2024.

Argentum Online Staff

notes.title: Welcome to the Prehistoric Odyssey Season!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/d793f0529e2e0d1f78fcbfe5cb5d848ed9b1830b.png[/img]

New Season Patch Notes (1/5/24)
Updated Wiki! https://ao20.com.ar/wiki


[b]1 - Mapping:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Jourmut continent was added as a safe zone with very low experience and gold so that new users can learn to play.
[*] At level 1 the characters start in Forgat, having access to the classic newbie dungeon or training on the outskirts of this new city.
[*] To travel between the old and new continents, you can board the ship at the port of Nix or the port of Arghal. The ticket has a low and affordable price of gold.
[*] Moved the four maps of New Hope to the old Nix Archipelago area, and removed the Priest and Banker from that unsafe city.
[*] The game's cities were graphically updated.
[*] The Magma Dungeon and Nagas Dungeon maps have been removed.
[*] Access from Pirate Island to the Giant Kraken remained with two NON-MAGIC maps.
[*] Boss maps are only accessible for levels +40.
[*] The island of Eleuria (snow map where hiding or the invisibility spell does not work) was added to the old New Hope area. The Glacier Cave was incorporated, accessible from Eleuria, aimed at training from level 33.
[*] The Cave of Desolation was added between the cities of Banderbill and Arghal, a training-oriented dungeon between levels 15 and 25.
[*] Moved access to the silver mines to the “Otto Island” map, northwest of Nix, accessible by navigation.
[*] Added the city of Eldoria as a navigable city (+25) south of Pitonisa, and updated the city of Lindos as a navigable city (+25).
[*] A new dungeon called Abandoned Lair has been added at level +40, accessible from the Lost Island, north of the desert.
[*] The Penthar Farm Map is now unsafe.
[*] The NPC April <Quest> will allow you to change the drops of the new NPCs in the Basements of the Patreon Houses.
[/list]

[b]2 - Training areas and quests[/b]

NPCs in all training zones have been re-balanced, both in life, gold and experience. You can see the ingame information by accessing the map. [b]A training guide and quests depending on the level were incorporated into the wiki [url=https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki]Wiki[/url][/b]

[i]a) Dungeons limited by level[/i]
[list]
[*] Mausoleum, Cave of Desolation: level 15 to 24
[*] Drainage: from level 15
[*] Pyramid: level 17 to 26
[*] Catacombs level 2: level 20 to 29
[*] Dungeon Dragon and Dungeon Marabel: from level 20
[*] Escape ducts (non-magical): from level 20
[*] Mountain (non-magical): from level 25
[*] Veril Dungeon and Glacier Cave: from level 33
[*] Ruins of Earost (non-magical): from level 33
[*] Legendary Dragon's Lair, Abandoned Lair and Fortune Teller Island: from level 40
[/list]

[i]b) Quests[/i]

The following dungeons or training areas have 3 quests with experience and gold rewards: Mausoleum, Cave of Desolation, Drain, Pyramid, Catacombs Level 2, Dragon Dungeon, Swamp, Desert, Hope, Elven Forest, Mountain, Usurped Island, Eleuria, Dungeon Veril, Ruins of Earost, Pythoness, Lair of the Legendary Dragon.

[b]3 - Skills assignable by level[/b]
[list]
[*] The wizard will continue to earn 5 points per level
[*] The worker will continue to earn 6 points per level
[*] All other classes will earn 6 points per level instead of 5
[/list]

[b]4 - Items and spells[/b]
[list]
[*] The resurrect spell now requires 87 magic skills and 400 mana
[*] The boat now asks for 15,000 common firewood
[*] The initial Magic Wave spell is replaced by the Magic Dart
[*] The silver sword goes from having a maximum hit of 19 to 20
[*] The sword of the heroes of the game is removed
[*] The Viking helmet is removed from the game
[*] The only item that will require gold bars will be the Dragon Slayer sword
[*] Crafting items with common firewood will be equal to crafting items with iron ores, and crafting items with elven firewood will be equal to crafting items with silver ores (next patch).
[/list]

[b]5 - Class balance[/b]

[list]
[*] The Pirate and Thief classes will be unsupported in-game. Although they are not disabled, they will not be able to equip any object, leaving the class aside for this version (it will be updated by date)
[*] Reduced mage evasion from 0.4 to 0.2
[*] Bard's evasion reduced from 1.25 to 1.2
[*] Assassin's weapon hit increased from 0.9 to 0.95
[*] Bandit shield defense reduced from 1.6 to 1.3
[/list]

[b]6 - Equipment items by class[/b]

[list]
[*] The mage no longer equips +1 dagger
[*] Completed the druid's flat-strike weapon equipment (without stabbing): Novice's Sword > Saber > Celtic Sword > Scimitar > Staff of Elements.
[*] The druid no longer uses daggers.
[*] The clergyman

notes.title: BabelUI is now Open Source.
notes.content:
[u]BabelUI is now Open Source.[/u]

This is our engine to run the experimental UI

The purpose of this project is to add support for creating a React interface for a Visual Basic 6 application. To achieve this, we utilize Ultralight as the HTML engine. However, since the engine operates exclusively in 64-bit, and VB6 only runs in 32-bit, we have developed a 32-bit API for VB6. This API spawns a 64-bit background process to execute the HTML and employs shared memory to handle communication.

The solution is composed of 2 binaries:

[b]BabelUI.dll[/b]
This VB6 API module handles the spawning of child processes and converts all VB6 calls into events that can be processed by the background process.

[b]BabelSlave.exe[/b]
The main function of this executable is to render the HTML content. Additionally, it renders the current HTML state to a buffer and sends it to the API for display within the VB6 application. This process also manages the loading of game resources, allowing the HTML to display game content seamlessly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/6927be5a330c888d56c5158be69706273ec19f96.png[/img]

- VB6 uses the API interface to send any user interactions such as mouse movements, key presses, or any other actions required by the client logic from the UI, such as changing menus.
- Since VB6 is single-threaded, we cannot directly call UI events. Instead, BabelApi stores all pending events from the UI (such as button presses). Then, VB6 requests an update from the main thread, and all callbacks are executed.
- BabelApi converts all API calls to events and stores them in shared memory.
- BabelSlave retrieves all events from the shared memory and calls the required functions in JavaScript, handle any js function callback and send it back to the api, it also load any resource required by the game like icons for the inventory

https://github.com/ao-org/BabelUI

Since VB6 is single-threaded, we cannot directly call UI events.
Instead, BabelApi stores all pending events from the UI (such as button presses).
Then, VB6 requests an update from the main thread, and all callbacks are executed.
BabelApi converts all API calls to events and stores them in shared memory.

BabelSlave retrieves all events from the shared memory and calls the required functions in JavaScript, handle any js function callback and send it back to the api, it also load any resource required by the game like icons for the inventory

notes.title: News in Items for Patreons
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We share with you the values and statistics of the Mounts available in the Patreon Merchant of Mesón Hostigado, we also change the value of the Backpack/Meditation Books for a number more in line with the length of the season, these values are subject to modifications in the upcoming seasons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/2a9cd2eed14ad4e328765a4b2d2e407b243f591b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Reins of the Young Golden Dragon: 1000 credits, you need 80 in Survival to ride it, grants 1.1 speed.
[*] Reins of the Young Cárdeno Dragon: 1000 credits, you need 80 in Survival to be able to ride it, it grants 1.1 speed.
[*] Reins of the Young Red Dragon: 1000 credits, you need 80 in Survival to ride it, grants 1.1 speed.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Reins of the Adult Golden Dragon: 1250 credits, you need 100 in Survival to be able to ride it, it grants 1.13 speed.
[*] Reins of the Adult Cárdeno Dragon: 1250 credits, 100 in Survival is needed to ride it, it grants 1.13 speed.
[*] Reins of the Adult Red Dragon: 1250 credits, you need 100 in Survival to be able to ride it, it grants 1.13 speed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Backpack (unlocks an inventory row): 1000 credits
[*] Spirit book (activates different styles of meditations): 400 credits
[/list]

[b][IMPORTANT][/b] These items are UNTRANSFERABLE, so you have to go to the Patreon merchant with the PC you are going to use.

Greetings!

notes.content:
[b]Black Dragon Season[/b]

It will begin on March 1 at 00:00 for Patreons members, and on March 2 at 00:00 access will be enabled for the general public.

[list]
[*] The season will last 60 days
[*] The experience modifier will be x4
[*] The extraction modifier will be x2
[*] Gold modifier remains at x1
[/list]

[b]Class Balance:[/b]
The balance modifications can be seen in the wiki (https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/balance) and are already reflected in the production server. You are invited to update the game, review them and leave us your feedback so we can finish polishing it between now and 1/3.

[b]Patreons:[/b]
Patreon shop item credits reduced! The new prices can be seen from the wiki (https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/items-patreon) or by visiting the Mesón Hostigado within the game.
Starting March 1st, new mounts exclusive to the Patreon shop will be added: the Reins of Dragons. The Young Dragon Reins will cost 1000 credits and the Adult Dragon Reins will cost 1250 credits.
The new reins, like the Backpacks currently are, will be non-transferable. They are acquired with the character they are going to use and cannot be thrown away or traded with another user.
Coming soon: limit of character slots in the account. Those who support the project with Patreon will be able to have access to more slots to create characters.


[b]Theme of the Season:[/b]
The action of the version will be centered on a new +40 map within the Dragon Dungeon where, those who want to get the Black Dragon Season Set, will fight tirelessly against dragons and other users for dominance of the map. Upon death, new NPCs will have a chance to drop their claws and quests will be enabled to exchange them for a Season item for your class. Once the season ends, these Black Dragon items will no longer be available as Black Dragon drops as they were until today, giving way to a new version of Argentum Online, with a different seasonal theme.
Its opening is planned for the fourth week of the version, so it is recommended to take advantage of the start of the game to rise to level 40, organize with your clan and prepare for battle!

[b]Items: [/b]
Beginner Items: All classes in the game will start with their own set of what they will equip throughout the game.
There were major changes in the balance of items, their main parameters, where to get them, and what class they belong to, differentiating them by tiers or levels:
tier 0: beginner equipment
tier 1: equipment for sale for levels -25
tier 2: equipment on sale for levels +25
tier 3: craftable equipment
Tier 4: Legendary Chest Gear
Tier 5: Black Dragon Team (starting in the fourth week)
All updated item information will be found in the new class manuals, soon available on discord and the wiki. These manuals will allow you to reduce all the existing items in the game to those that can be equipped by a particular class, facilitating the knowledge of your character.

[b]NPCs:[/b]
The statistics (HP, EXP, GOLD) of the NPCs in the following areas have been modified:
Newbie Dungeon
Nix Archipelago
Cemetery
Pyramid
Dungeon Dragon
Naga Island
Swamp
Eleusis
New Hope
Sea of Leviathans
Mountain
Elven Forest
Pythonisa Island
Forest and Sea NPCs that don't belong in a dungeon
5 Clan Foundation: changes in the requirements to found a clan. Now you can found someone who is level 25, has 35 points assigned in Leadership, and has the 4 Foundation Gems, items obtainable with a 100% droprate by defeating:
Drain Boss → Har Nareth 100,000 HP // Drop 100% Green Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 2 badges)
Earost Ruins Boss: Giant Kraken 100,000 HP // Drop 100% Blue Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 2 badges)
Swamp Boss → Grim Titan 200,000 HP // Drop 100% Red Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 3 badges)
Polar Gulf Boss: Etzbron Frostwind 200,000 HP // Drop 100% Polar Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 3 badges)
Fact: The Gorgon Queen (Boss of Pythoness Island +40) can drop up to 4 insignia, but she does not drop an item necessary for the founding of the clan.

[b]Mapping:[/b]
The Magma Dungeon will remain closed for the entire version (it is likely that it will disappear from the map in one of the patches for this version, or in a future one, to make way for the emergence of another training place)
The island of Pythonisa will remain the only exclusive training location for levels +40, maintaining certain NPCs and new additions (this change is already reflected in the game currently).
Access to Jourmut was disabled, entering a new stage of development to implement it in future versions, in a more optimal and balanced way.
Access to Eldoria, the city of the Elves, is maintained through a portal east of Ullathorpe.
Quest:
The training areas will have their own quests, with which the gold reward will be encouraged, and in turn, those that have the property of being repeatable, will generate an incentive for those who wish to progress to a faster level.
The Special Class Skills quests from last season have been disabled: they will not be available this season, but they may be reinstated in the future with better balance and testing.

[b]Alchemy:[/b]
This new system will offer the possibility of crafting potions to those who wish to do so. It will begin with the availability of the recipes for life and mana potions, only purchasable for the Worker class, and as the seasons progress, the rest will be added. The information will be available soon on the Wiki.

[b]Tailoring:[/b]
Adjustments were made to the skin requirements on certain tailoring items, and Tiger Skin and Bengal Tiger Skin were added to the game.
The information is available at https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/sastreria

[b]Carpentry:[/b]
Updated the wood requirements for carpentry items, their values, and for some items, their attack statistics were modified. The information is available at https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/carpinteria

[b]Legendary Chests:[/b]
Spell Chest temporarily disabled: Legendary Spells are under review to give each spell a better balance.
The Legendary Armor Chest was updated: changes in the defense values of some of them, reduction in their magic resistance to 1%, and class assignment of each one.
The Helmets and Shields Chest was divided into two independent chests where each class will have at least one legendary item, except for shields for the mage and druid and both for the worker.
[b]Spells:[/b]
Disabled special abilities for each class in the latest version
Added a starting base damage spell for all mana classes - this requires 0 magic to use.
Modifications were made to where each spell is purchased and its damage, the information is available at https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/hechizos

[b]Factions:[/b]
The regulations of both factions were modified, these are available in PDF format in the faction section of the Official Discord and on the web.
Modified the defenses of the Factional Armors / Tunics
Changed the requirements for Faction Hierarchies.
[IMPORTANT] The factional pardon was eliminated: those users who wish to enlist in a faction and have an impediment due to having murdered a member of the same, will not be able to request the factional pardon. If the character is acquired via MAO, neither; The statistics of a character's deaths in the MAO are public, for everyone to see.

[b]PVP:[/b]
The manual deletion of the magic words (sign) is re-enabled, but maintaining the automatic deletion with a minimum time.
Invisibility will no longer go away when attacking, returning to classic invi.
A nerf was applied to the Magic Resistance skill, so that having it at 0 does not take excessive magic damage.
Removed magic penetration from staffs, flutes, and lauds, which disabled magic resistance items such as hats, helmets, or rings.

notes.title: Argentum Online
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/caafbbb2b9c07ac32b4f130359c8dfd7ace933fc.png[/img]

Argentum Online, also known as AO, is an open-source project, whose last "official" change was made on July 17th, 2012 (v0.13).

From our end, we created an anniversary version for the 20 years of Argentum Online in 2020, which, thanks to people's support, is still alive. This effort also aimed to give the community the opportunity to create their own version of Argentum Online and submit improvements, by creating an active Github organization where the project's source code and all necessary tools are available to everyone.

We, as the current maintainers of the project in this year when AO will turn 24, want to remind the community of the opportunity to collaborate with the project, where everyone is invited to participate in its development by submitting improvements, changes, fixes, among other things, in order to preserve and continue evolving this cultural phenomenon.

As part of our changes and implementations in the workflow, we will carry out the following in the project:


[list]
[*] Argentum20 will be renamed Argentum Online.
[*] We will use the domain [url=http://www.argentumonline.com.ar/]http://www.argentumonline.com.ar/[/url].
[*] In each new release, both server and client, we will upload the executables so that you can create private servers locally.
[*] Historical preservation: all changelogs (changes) from the original repositories will be migrated so that anyone who has contributed to the source code of Argentum Online on Sourceforge will appear on Github (more information [url=https://medium.com/@requitolucas/importar-repositorio-cvs-a-git-sourceforge-a-github-de-manera-fácil-20c63344bfa5]Click here for more information[/url]).
[/list]
Thank you very much to everyone for the support.
Argentum Online

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/08
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/5919bd51fe6d97eb6d4c01372b6ee8e2749a11ac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/03a6a09a0a1fd82d49cbc7fc47b80c3f5c4aaf56.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/ef40b3a7a44f64e046891b9ea897c5eb7f3d8900.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/ed9c11e8678e84b799c931a99e58b39d3f70c4be.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 👋

We are pleased to announce that we have incorporated the "Easy AntiCheat" system that will allow us to reduce the use of external programs and provide you with a safer gaming experience. In relation to this change, from now on only users who use Windows 10/11 will be able to continue playing. We understand the discomfort of users who continue using Windows 7/8 but it is important to keep in mind that Steam will also stop supporting these operating systems on its platform in a few more days, so we recommend that you update your operating system as soon as possible.

Additionally, in the Experimental UI we have improved the game Map and the Skills window, now you will be able to search and find NPCs more easily, explore the various maps of the old and new continent, as well as access information about Dungeons and Safe Zones or Insecure.
We suggest you activate this function from the game settings, in the video section. We hope you enjoy this new experience at Argentum 20!


[b]Balance:[/b]
-The number of NPCs on the maps was reduced: 805, 162, 837, 394, 577 and 578

notes.title: We start with the BETA of the new season of AO20!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/907639ef0f334b81f03eb720db16f7044e5bca46.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We bring you news about the BETA version of the upcoming season of AO20. Before going into details, let's remember some important dates and technical aspects:

The BETA version will be available until September 06. During these weeks, we will be making changes to experience and in-game gold earning so that everyone can easily try out the new things we have implemented.

[i]Here are the variations for each week:[/i]

  [list]
[*] Week from 08/01 to Tuesday 08: Experience and gold multiplied by 5.
[*] Week from 08/08 to Tuesday 15: Experience and gold multiplied by 10.
  [*] Week from 08/15 to Wednesday 06/09: Experience multiplied by 15.
[/list]
It is essential for us to receive your queries and reports about any bugs or errors you find while playing the BETA version. With your feedback, we will be able to make any necessary adjustments to make the AO20 experience optimal.

On [b]09/07[/b], active patrons will have the exclusive chance to create characters and start playing the final version 24 hours before the rest.

Finally, on [b]09/08[/b], everyone must create new accounts and characters to access the final version of the new season of AO20.

[b]We hope you enjoy this BETA and help us improve AO20 with your feedback! See you in the game![/b]

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ----------

[u][b]List of Changes:[/b][/u]


[b]Invisible Attack:[/b] Attacking while invisible will now turn you visible for a few seconds, adding a tactical element and balancing the use of this ability.

[b]Wallet Changes:[/b] to ensure you don't lose the gold you carry with you. Now, the wallet has a capacity to cover up to 7.5k gold per level, which means that you will be able to protect a considerable amount of your earnings. If the gold in your wallet is covered by your level it will be painted yellow, otherwise it will be red and you can lose your gold if you are killed.

[b]Changes in life: [/b]life is always maintained on average, respecting the stats of the race and class selected in the character.

[b]Damage on Stab:[/b] The damage dealt by stab attacks has been halved to prevent instant kills and balance the impact of the new Assassin poisons. This measure also seeks to encourage the use of different variants of daggers.

[b]Equipment and Training:[/b] These changes are intended to incentivize mages to better equip themselves to improve their performance in training and face stronger challenges.

[b]Evasion and Hit Chance:[/b] Reduced the evasion of all classes equally to increase the chance to hit enemies overall. Chance to hit is now set to 50% as a baseline.

[b]Summons:[/b] The power of summons will now depend on the mage's level. Additionally, the damage dealt by summons will be influenced by the staff the mage is holding at the time they are summoned.

[b]Player Magic Resist:[/b] Players now have a new "Magic Resist" skill that will allow them to mitigate the effects of enemy spells.

[b]Magic Resist for Creatures:[/b] Added the "Magic Resist" attribute to creatures. Players will need to take this factor into account when launching magical attacks against them. Damage dealt will be reduced by 2% for each point of difference between the player's magic ability and the creature's magic resist.

[b]Factions and Points System:[/b] A new points-based faction system has been introduced. Players get points for killing other characters, but the number of points depends on the level difference between the attacker and the target. Assists also award points, but in smaller amounts. The last five players to have killed a character will not gain additional points for killing them again.

[b]Targeting in Party Portraits:[/b] Re-enabled targeting in party portraits, making it easier to coordinate and track allies in combat.

[b]Mage Rods and Spells:[/b] All mage rods will affect spell performance. It is no longer necessary to possess certain types of staff/staff/wand to cast spells. Additionally, all staves will now increase damage as described in their descriptions, removing the previous 30% penalty.

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ----------

[u][b]New skills by Class[/b][/u]

[b][u]Pirate:[/u][/b]
Firearms ignore enemies' armor.

[b]Harpoon: [/b]Deals damage and applies a "slow" effect that slows the target for several seconds.
[b]Pocket Cannon: [/b]Fires a cannonball that explodes upon hitting the target, dealing area damage. Damage decreases as you move away from the center of the explosion.

[b][u]Cleric:[/u][/b]
[b]Restoration:[/b] Heals between 25-40 health every 1.5 seconds, casting a total of 8 heals.
[b]Divine Protection:[/b] Grants a shield that absorbs up to 200 damage to the target. Lasts 30 seconds or until shield depletes.
[b]Blessing:[/b] Removes a debuff from the target.
[b]Penance:[/b] Mark the target; the next damage taken by the target does 120% damage.

[u][b]Druid:[/b][/u]
[b]Restoration:[/b] Heals between 25-40 health every 1.5 seconds, casting a total of 8 heals.
[b]Regrowth:[/b] The target receives extra healing from all sources (spells, potions, etc.). Requires the Forest Spirit form.
[b]Rend:[/b] Applies a bleed that deals damage over time.
[b]Fast Movement: [/b]Increases movement speed for a few seconds. Requires Wolf form.

[b]Transformations:[/b]
[b]Wolf:[/b] Increases evasion and chance to hit, but does not allow casting magic on other targets (only on itself).
[b]Bear:[/b] Reduces damage taken by 20%, reduces damage dealt with magic by 30%, and increases chance to hit.
[b]Forest Spirit:[/b] Increases magic damage by 5% and heals done by 10%. Consumes more mana while active and slows movement speed.

[u][b]Bard:[/b][/u]
[b]Scores: [/b]Applies a buff to self and nearby party members.
[b]Regeneration:[/b] Regenerates a percentage of mana per second.
[b]Fast Echo:[/b] Increases movement speed.
[b]Harmonic Accuracy:[/b] Increases the chance to hit.
[b]Edge Serenade:[/b] Increases character's evasion.

[u][b]
Bandit:[/b][/u]
[b]Quick Hits:[/b] The next 3 hits deal 3 hits for 40% of the damage.
[b]Steal Magic:[/b] Steals a buff from the target and applies it to himself.

[u][b]Murderer:[/b][/u]
[b]Poisons: [/b]Applies a poison to the weapon that inflicts an effect on the target when hit.
[b]Mana Poison:[/b] Applies a buff that drains a percentage of mana every second.
[b]Stackable Poison:[/b] Applies a poison on each hit that does 15-25 damage per second. It can be applied multiple times, accumulating the damage dealt. Has a bonus chance to hit with daggers.

[u][b]Warrior:[/b][/u]
[b]Viking Axe:[/b] You can hit in melee or throw it to cause a "stun" that lasts approximately 1 second.
[b]Phalanx: [/b]Reduces damage taken by 50% and damage dealt by 25%.
[b]Extended Cut:[/b] Allows you to hit multiple targets at once with reduced damage. Hits 75% of the target in front and 50% of those to the sides of it.
[b]Taunt: [/b]Applies a buff to all enemies in the area, reducing their damage to other targets and prompting them to attack the warrior. Slows the warrior's movement speed and prevents him from turning invisible.

[u][b]Hunter:[/b][/u]
[b]Charged Arrow: [/b]Deals a small amount of damage and pushes the target several tiles away.
[b]Arrow Dance:[/b] Fires 5 arrows that spread out in a cone in the direction of the target, hitting whatever is in the way. Each arrow does 30% damage.
[b]Traps:[/b] Allows you to leave up to 3 traps on the ground. Each lasts up to 2 minutes or until someone steps on them.
[b]Root:[/b] Applies "Root" to the target.
[b]Explosive: [/b]Explodes and deals damage to the target when activated.
[b]Poison:[/b] Applies poison to the target upon stepping on it.

tags.balance_change: [b]Invisible Attack:[/b] Attacking while invisible will now turn you visible for a few seconds, adding a tactical element and balancing the use of this ability.

[b]Wallet Changes:[/b] to ensure you don't lose the gold you carry with you. Now, the wallet has a capacity to cover up to 7.5k gold per level, which means that you will be able to protect a considerable amount of your earnings. If the gold in your wallet is covered by your level it will be painted yellow, otherwise it will be red and you can lose your gold if you are killed.
[b]Changes in life: [/b]life is always maintained on average, respecting the stats of the race and class selected in the character.

[b]Damage on Stab:[/b] The damage dealt by stab attacks has been halved to prevent instant kills and balance the impact of the new Assassin poisons. This measure also seeks to encourage the use of different variants of daggers.
[b]Equipment and Training:[/b] These changes are intended to incentivize mages to better equip themselves to improve their performance in training and face stronger challenges.
[b]Evasion and Hit Chance:[/b] Reduced the evasion of all classes equally to increase the chance to hit enemies overall. Chance to hit is now set to 50% as a baseline.
[b]Summons:[/b] The power of summons will now depend on the mage's level. Additionally, the damage dealt by summons will be influenced by the staff the mage is holding at the time they are summoned.
[b]Player Magic Resist:[/b] Players now have a new "Magic Resist" skill that will allow them to mitigate the effects of enemy spells.

[b]Magic Resist for Creatures:[/b] Added the "Magic Resist" attribute to creatures. Players will need to take this factor into account when launching magical attacks against them. Damage dealt will be reduced by 2% for each point of difference between the player's magic ability and the creature's magic resist.

[b]Factions and Points System:[/b] A new points-based faction system has been introduced. Players get points for killing other characters, but the number of points depends on the level difference between the attacker and the target. Assists also award points, but in smaller amounts. The last five players to have killed a character will not gain additional points for killing them again.
[b]Targeting in Party Portraits:[/b] Re-enabled targeting in party portraits, making it easier to coordinate and track allies in combat.

[b]Mage Rods and Spells:[/b] All mage rods will affect spell performance. It is no longer necessary to possess certain types of staff/staff/wand to cast spells. Additionally, all staves will now increase damage as described in their descriptions, removing the previous 30% penalty.

notes.title: 7/11/23 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/7877611b188b1bf68cd0e4a7924cfdbab26e0626.jpg[/img]

[b]11/07/23 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]News:[/b]
We updated the new user interface (still in development) and added the gameplay screen.
 
[b]Changes:[/b]
◉ As long as a pet or summon is not in combat, it will be able to exchange positions with the player that moves in its direction.
◉ We have increased the number of deposits available and reduced the amount of resources that can be extracted from them.
◉ Summons can be used within safe zones other than cities.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
◉ We have expanded the level restriction of “Gorgon Cave” (434) so that even max level characters (47) can access it.
◉ The “Shadow Armor (E/G)” can only be equipped by those characters of the “dwarf” or “gnome” race respectively.
◉ We adjusted the name of the maps “South Shores” (521); “North Sea” (452) and “Alta Mar” (504).
◉ Removed a series of blocks from the following locations: “Arghal City” (151); “Arghal Gate” (161) and “Arkhein City” (195).
◉ Fixed a bug in the challenge system that prevented taking the items at the end of the challenge.

notes.title: Patch Notes 06/16/23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/979f467e211d139c9f3e570e6d129efaa008abe4.jpg[/img]

[b]**News:**[/b]
**•** Added two new shields for members of the “Dark Legion”: the “Legion Fortress Shield” (Def. 10/13) and the “Dark Legion Shield” (Def. 15/17).
These shields can be obtained through "Tiberius <Legion Equipment", which is located at coordinates 52-56 of the "Harassed Inn" (170). For the first they will have to deliver 300 iron ingots; silver and gold while for the second he will request 5 "Red Badge".
We also added the "Boca Juniors" shield for patreons that can be obtained for 200 credits at the NPC Merchant of the Inn.

[b]**Changes:**[/b]
**•** Cut the travel time of the /home command in half.
The transfer occurs in 105 seconds (1 minute and 45 seconds) instead of the usual 210 (3 minutes and 30 seconds).
**•** Reduced the minimum level required to complete the “Brute Force” and “Swiftness in the Woods” quests. The first requires them to be level 14 instead of level 20, while the second requires them to be level 8 instead of 18.
**•** The following armors can only be equipped by female characters: “Plain Breastplate”; "Red Composite Shell"; "Brown Mantle Mail"; "Mesh Coat to Measure"; "Light Chainmail"; "One-piece Chainmail"; "Travel Chain Mail"; "Crusade Armor"; “Reddish Elven Sirica” and “Combined Tunic (E/G)”.
**•** Added the male version of the following armors: “Green Mantle Rings”; "Long Chainmail" and "Composite Armor".
**•** Replaced the sound played when using the “Sewing Box” so that it resembles that of scissors cutting through fabric.
**•** Removed the "Bottle with a Message" from the list of items that can be obtained by fishing.
**•** The “Empty Bottle” can be recharged at both the “Arghal Gate” (156) and “Arkheim City” (196) fountains.
**•** Removed “Grey the Collector” from “Harassed Inn (170); to “Kandal” from the “Banderbill Suburbs” (58) and to “Malvur” from the “Puerto de Pescadores” (254).


[b]**Bug fixes:**[/b]
**•** The command /home transports you to the destination city, regardless of where it is located.
**•** The “Catacombs Lvl2” door graphic shows whether the door is open or closed.
**•** The floating bar that indicates the status of the members of the "Group" no longer shows the information of our character.
**•** When delivering the mission “The Legendary” both the “Infernal Amulet” and the “Gorgona Amulet” are removed from the inventory.
**•** Adjusted the orientation of the “Winged Hussar Helmet” to display left to right and right to left based on the direction you are facing.
**•** Fixed the values of the “Dagger of the Royal Army” item so that it can be used by Assassins of that faction.
**•** “Mithril Dagger” is shown with its own graphic instead of using the “Bloody Dagger” one.
**•** The graphic displayed when equipping the "Imperial Worker Armor"; the “Chaos Worker Armor” or “Dwarf Clothes” corresponds to the one shown in the inventory.
**•** Updated the transition between the following maps: “Drain” (329 and 333); “Southern Banderbill Forest” (68 and 67) and “Swamp” (233 and 229).
**•** Removed a series of blocks in the following locations: “Catacombs Lvl2” (291; 292 and 293); "Swamp" (233); “Earost Ruins Hideout” (284); "Earost Ruins" (285); "Usurped Island" (100); "Frozen Shores" (352); "Magma Dungeon" (367); "Pitonisa Island" (434); “South East Ullathorpe Forest” (14); “Northwest Ullathorpe Forest” (74); “Banderbill Pier” (61); "Forest" (186); "West Coasts" (10); "High Seas" (458 and 465).

[u][b]News:[/b][/u]
-By default, a floating bar is displayed on the left of the screen indicating the life of the group members. It refreshes the moment damage is taken or health is restored.
They can optionally hide or show it at will.

-Added a forge and anvil in the “City of Arghal” (151). With which, you can create ingots and any other manufacturing object.
-Updated the animation effect of the “Ghost Galleon” attack so that it fires a cannonball instead of casting “Firestorm”.

-We reorganized the messages that reflect the damage produced and/or received.
-We established the map “Drainage” (336) as a dungeon.
-We checked the spelling and grammar of the available missions.
-Adjusted the tooltip for red potions to say they restore 27 health instead of 30.
